description: Implementation of DeviceType utilities including name conversion, validation, streaming, and backend registration within the c10 namespace.

methods.name: DeviceTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name of a DeviceType, optionally in lowercase.

methods.name: isValidDeviceType
methods.description: Checks if a DeviceType value is valid.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads stream insertion operator to output DeviceType as string.

methods.name: get_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Retrieves the registered privateuse1 backend name, optionally in lowercase.

methods.name: register_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Registers a new privateuse1 backend name, ensuring it is valid and not already set.

methods.name: is_privateuse1_backend_registered
methods.description: Checks if a privateuse1 backend has been registered.
